TASK_COMPLEXITY.SIMPLE: Clear scope, no delegation/peer-review/user-loop needed — orchestrator analyzes directly.
TASK_COMPLEXITY.COMPLEX: Exploratory, needs delegation, planning, peer review, and user feedback loops.

STAGE.INTERPRETATION: Clarifying an ambiguous prompt with the user before any analysis.
STAGE.PLANNING: study_designer_agent producing or revising design.md for the current phase.
STAGE.PEER_REVIEW: peer_reviewer_agent DESIGN-REVIEW or RESULTS-REVIEW for the current phase.
STAGE.USER_FEEDBACK: Presenting design.md/report.md to the user and collecting their response.
STAGE.EXECUTION: Dispatching phase tasks to specialist subagents.
STAGE.REPORTING: Compiling or presenting the final report.md after FINAL_PHASE.
